- Open Design Motion is the 0.25.0 release of Open Design — the open-source alternative to Claude Motion.

- Works with any agent (Hermes, OpenCode, Antigravity, Claude Code) and free models.

- Pair it with Blotato to auto-post videos and track analytics.

Open Design is a local-first, open-source workspace where AI agents create designs: websites, apps, dashboards, slide decks, documents, images — and now, with the Motion release, videos.
